note: Claim: the Virgo page runs the same three-system comparison for another tropical sign. Target's coreSummary says 'Western tropical astrology ... places Virgo from August 23 to September 22', 'Vedic sidereal astrology ... puts Virgo roughly a month later' and 'The actual astronomical constellation ... holds the Sun longer still', so tropical, sidereal and constellation are all compared.

Claim: June 22 has its own Wikipedia-versus-publisher one-day gap. Target says 'Wikipedia's entry on Cancer (astrology) opens by stating that "the Sun transits this area between approximately June 22 and July 23,"' while 'AstroStyle and Farmers' Almanac both give the sign's range as June 21 to July 22', a day apart.
